notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI runs the keepalive CMSG_PING loop, measures round-trip on SMSG_PONG into NetworkClient.LatencyMs, and draws the main-bar performance meter from the real UI-MainMenuBar-PerformanceBar art tinted by the FrameXML thresholds (green <=300 ms, yellow <=600, red above) with a 'Latency: Nms' tooltip.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Benilla averages a 16-deep RTT ring (the reference's history) where MSUI reports the latest single sample, and MSUI updates the tint continuously rather than on the reference's 10 s poll - both make the meter twitchier than the reference but the color law and thresholds agree.
